title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射」的「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: mechanism and system boundary” in “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" is correct?
options: 銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。
自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
optionsEn: A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.

LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz.
FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
quiz.explanation: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。
脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。
銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。
optionsEn: Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.

Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m.
quiz.explanation: 銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration"?
options: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。
optionsEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen).
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K.
quiz.explanation: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現。
自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once.
FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
quiz.explanation: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “112 m undulator and SASE gain” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “112 m undulator and SASE gain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FEL output power is proportional to undulator length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “112 m undulator and SASE gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和
knowledge.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation
knowledge.text: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。
knowledge.textEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: FEL output power is proportional to undulator length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation" is correct?
options: 自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。
optionsEn: FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.

Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE.
quiz.explanation: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “112 m undulator and SASE gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。
knowledge.textEn: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation", which statement holds?
options: 自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。
optionsEn: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴.
An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K.
quiz.explanationEn: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “112 m undulator and SASE gain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平。
機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m.
Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost.
quiz.explanation: 量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “112 m undulator and SASE gain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FEL output power is proportional to undulator length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。
knowledge.textEn: If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.

If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes.
quiz.explanation: 能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
